description.zh-cn: 原生动画试验：全体敌人的常规近战攻击速度 +20%，同步命中、连击、扫击与动作时长。需要配套动画资源；目前仅支持本地单人/机器人房间。尚未通过实机验证。

description.en: Native-controller experiment: +20% ordinary enemy melee playback and matching hit, combo, sweep and end timings. Requires matching controller resources. Local solo/bot sessions only; not yet validated in the game.
